label: D2 arrival at S2 after a rewarded trial, early in the episode (high value)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and almost only when S2 is reached (99% of mass): when the S2 input is shown. Almost all of it (97%) comes after the previous trial was rewarded, and it is confined to the first ~30 trials of an episode (peaks at trials 10-19, nearly silent after trial 40), when the model value is in its top bin (>8.1). Mostly common a2->S2 trials in S2-good streaks (87% of mass), but the largest activations (top ~10) are rare a1->S2 transitions after S2 had been good and rewarded. Never fires at D1/GO, on S1 arrivals, or after unrewarded trials. All variables are observable at D2. The early-episode dependence limits precision: within the predicate only ~45% of steps are active, so the unit is gated by something time-like or a slowly drifting hidden-state level that the predicate approximates with ep_trial. Simpler (phase==D2)&(state==2)&(prev_reward==1)&(ep_trial<30) scores dev F1 0.51; adding action==2 instead of value gives F1 0.61 but lower mass recall (0.87).
